title: Interpolate Curve Disappears On Finish
summary: Committed + Error(1) was interaction.emptyCommit: WASM worker postMessage did not serialize nested params.model, so executeCommandDiff saw no model and returned {}. Deep serialize/deserialize for Model in RPC payloads; failed final-state commit restores the pre-finish undo snapshot (back to next_point) instead of leaving the session stuck in committed.
